**Stable ID:** `DATA-12.02` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 12 Contribution, freshness and maintenance

Define per-source freshness targets, how staleness is detected and how refreshes are scheduled.

## Deliverables

- Freshness targets per source class
- Staleness detection rules

- [ ] Each record has a last-checked date

- [ ] Refresh never overwrites without a new check
